entry.title: Space Resources Week
entry.content:
Space Resources Week link

I presented a work done in collaboration with the Space Economy Evolution Lab in SDA Bocconi and the Sapienza University of Rome. The work consists in a both tecnical and economic analysis with the objective of understanding if it makes sense from a business perspective for a private company to enter the domain of in space transportation, storage and distribution systems.

Download the slides [PDF]

entry.title: Mining the Moon for profit
entry.content:
link

This is a work done in collaboration with the Space Economy Evolution Lab in SDA Bocconi, we presented in the event on Mining the Moon for profit in March 2019. The work consists in a study where a business plan was constructed in order to understand if it is profitable to extract water from the Moon in order to use it as propellant to fuel Cislinar travel.

Download the slides [PDF]
